correctness.rationale: For positive D, 0<k1<k2 and strictly positive switching rates, stationary second-moment generator gives w=2D(2K-Q^T)^(-1)pi and stationary fourth moments z=12D(4K-Q^T)^(-1)w. Stationary covariance is 1^T exp[(Q^T-K)t]w, C(0)=v, C'(0+)=-D and satisfies a two-root ODE with trace T and determinant Delta. A single exponential requires rho=D/v and the characteristic equation, equivalent, after clearing strictly positive factors, to F=(alpha+beta)^2+2(beta-alpha)(k2-k1)-4k1k2=0. Solving the positive-rate locus gives alpha=(rho-k1)(rho+k2)/(k2-k1), beta=(k2-rho)(rho+k1)/(k2-k1) and k1<rho<k2. ODE uniqueness proves sufficiency. The computed fourth cumulant 9D^2(rho-k1)(k2-rho)/[rho^2(rho^2+rho(k1+k2)+3k1k2)] is strictly positive. My independent SymPy matrix inversion and characteristic identity checked the full symbolic rational identities, not only sample numbers. Excludes coincident stiffnesses, zero switching rates, nonstationary process and finite-data identification.
